ds.desktop.notify.service

Class NotifyService

  • java.lang.Object
    • ds.desktop.notify.service.NotifyService
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    NotifyClient, NotifyServer

    public abstract class NotifyService
extends java.lang.Object
    A NotifyService makes it possible to centralize control and display notifications in a single process for the current host (either a physical or virtual machine), in such a way several processes can make use of DS Desktop Notify without colliding with each other, even those where the Java platform is not necesarily present.

    Handling notifications this way has some limitations, as it is not possible to set any action events or use custom themes and icons. This is because the service is meant to dispatch notification requests coming from different VMs or native processes, being input through command line and/or network, and all the avaialble assets belong only to the process running the service.
    Since:
    0.9 (2019-06-18)

    • Method Detail

      • get

        public static NotifyService get()
        Returns the currently active notification service for this device. If there isn't any service running, a new service will be started and returned from here.

        Notification services work in such a way that only one service can be running at a time per host, across several VMs. For this, a socket port is internally reserved and used for communication.
        Returns:
        The notification service.

      • reset

        protected static void reset()

      • postNotification

        public abstract void postNotification(java.lang.String title,
                    java.lang.String message,
                    java.lang.Integer type,
                    java.lang.Integer align,
                    java.lang.Long timeout,
                    java.lang.String themeName)
        Posts a new notification to the service, setting the parameters needed for it.
        Parameters:
        title - The title to display.
        message - The message to display.
        type - The notification type (0~7).
        align - The text/layout alignment (0,1).
        timeout - The maximum time in milliseconds the notification will stay on screen.
        themeName - Either "light" or "dark", refering to the two stock themes available.
        See Also:
        DARK_THEME, LIGHT_THEME
